summary: Limited-time promo: new Docker Agentic Platform sign-ups get a one-time $250 Cloud Sandbox compute credit (instead of the standard $25), claimable September 22–26, 2026 11:59 PM PT. Credit applies to metered sandbox compute only; model/API usage is billed separately. Credit card required at signup; unused credit expires 6 months after redemption.
claim_steps: Open the Docker Sandboxes promotion page and use Claim my $250 credit (or sign up at app.docker.com).
Create or sign in to a Docker account and complete Docker Agentic Platform signup with a valid credit card (charged only for usage beyond the credit).
Limit one credit per user and account; claim during the offer window (terms: September 22–26, 2026, 11:59 PM PT).
Use Cloud Sandboxes via the web console or sbx CLI (sbx 0.45.1+); compute draws down the $250 credit first.

social_proof.title: Introducing Cloud Sandboxes: Start on Your Laptop, Finish in the Cloud
social_proof.text: Today, we're introducing Cloud Sandboxes: the same microVM-based sandbox, running on Docker-managed compute, with one command to move between them. Cloud Sandboxes are pay-as-you-go.

social_proof.text: To use cloud sandboxes, you need: The sbx CLI, version 0.45.0 or later; An active Docker Agentic Platform subscription.
